traditional: 拉埋 A 一齊 V
jyutping: laai1 maai4 A jat1 cai4 V

english.note: Use this when someone actively brings A into an activity, rather than A choosing to participate.

examples.english: We involve Ming by bringing him in to do homework with us.
examples.traditional: 我哋拉埋阿明一齊做功課。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 laai1 maai4 aa3 ming4 jat1 cai4 zou6 gung1 fo3
